title: Exterior shape and body lines
summary: Reviews mainly praise the car’s exterior shape, contours, and body lines, with a small number of comments that mention styling without a clear evaluative direction.

positive.summary: Positive reviews highlight attractive styling, pleasing contours, and a body shape that feels right or improved over the earlier model.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention the door shape or overall lines without enough context to confirm whether the feedback is favorable or critical.

limitations: The sample is small and stratified, so it should not be treated as representative of all owners.
Some fragments are too brief to determine clear sentiment, especially the comments about door shape and lines.
One positive example also mentions interior comfort and equipment, so not every fragment is exclusively about exterior styling.
